original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free.

first_step.inspect: Reproduce the 945-pairing control, then read Exact interface to list the allowed calls.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.

actual_scope: Resolve the released six-source DUO (13,16) handoff by an exhaustive expansion census, and certify the minimum source calls at W<=16 in the inherited complete-call dirty-connector model.
scope_change_reason: The original card asks for a new operation family. This continues PR2128 using the existing DUO alphabet, with an exact lower bound for its six-source witness; no new operation or implementation admission is claimed.
bottleneck_link: Scoped connector-interface side result: 14 source calls are necessary at the minimum universal source-add budget 16, hence the predecessor all-63-row (140 queries,142 adds) point is optimal at that add budget. This closes four named cells but does not supply a physical compiler/supplier or improve the selected kappa.
stop_rule: First wave limited to 20 minutes, three local CPU workers and 1 GiB aggregate process RSS, stopping on a witness, complete exhaustion or deadline. Exhaustion occurred in about three seconds. Publication requires complete independent enumeration and literal unpruned deletion replay. Stop this investigation after resolving the claimed cells; higher-add searches need a separate scoped round.
evidence: Two code-disjoint C++ enumerators enumerate all 54,864,810 normalized positive-even 16-step words and agree byte-for-byte on 7,480 full covers. Python partitions them into 251 complete dihedral/relabeling orbits and checks all 86,900 legal three-midpoint deletions without the native removability prune: maximum 63/64. A sharp near miss, the predecessor 14-call positive word, inherited singleton censuses, all 70/140/210 dirty input columns, four behavioral mutations and deadline rejection are checked. RESULT.json and FULL-COVERS.bin retain exact receipts; README proves the reduction and limits.
author: Tairitsu-Aya
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance with source reading, mathematics, implementation, verification and writing for Tairitsu-Aya. Both algorithms and the audit have the same author/assistant; no independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

open_questions.question: Independently validate the published unrestricted 14-point difference-basis minimum and its implication for the entire six-source DUO batch budget.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The 2017 published value would eliminate higher-add 12/13-call searches as well; a complete independently checked finite reduction avoids wasting computation on them.
open_questions.first_step: Normalize any spanning 13-point set to contain zero and the six basis vectors, then exhaust the 36,288,252 ways to choose six remaining points with two independent coverage computations.
open_questions.blocked_by: The restricted 16-add census does not itself establish completeness of that larger domain; the normalization and batch implications need review.

open_questions.question: Can a selected physical supplier implement a complete DUO call under its real frame, access, scratch-restoration and precision obligations?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The abstract connector point affects the multiplication construction only after all implementation costs and admissibility obligations are charged.
open_questions.first_step: Choose one pinned supplier and implement a small noncommuting arbitrary-input DUO fixture with explicit owner/frame transitions and a full charged invoice.
open_questions.blocked_by: This package contains no admitted physical DUO instance, compiler or complete supplier bill.
